correctness.rationale: Derived path counts a*C(b,2) and b*C(a,2), giving exact count-chain probabilities (b-1)/(s-2) and (a-1)/(s-2) for increments xi=+1 and -1 respectively; drift -d/(s-2). The stopped normalization h_{j+1}=h_j(s-3)/(s-2) makes M=d/h a martingale with h~(s/m)^(1/3). Variance sum until mesoscopic level s_c~sqrt(m) has asymptotic m, bounded normalized increments establish martingale CLT; Doob bounds early absorption. Below s_c fluctuations are o(sqrt m), so terminal |d|=s implies R/m^(1/4)->|Z+mu|^(3/2); macroscopic fluid intersection solves |delta|(s/m)^(1/3)=s/m. Independently reproduced exact small-state DP: for 8+8 terminal residue R=1 with 85/88 or R=4 with 3/88; for 8+6 R=2 with 211/216 or R=5 with 5/216. Asymptotic relies on full martingale/variance proof; finite DP not substitute.
